comment: Mirrors arbiter/tsconfig.json and interceptors/anthropic-proxy/tsconfig.json (NodeNext + strict). Scoped to the fs-sync package. The arbiter is a sibling package owned by another sub-agent; fs-sync declares the narrow arbiter surface it needs structurally (src/arbiter-client.ts) rather than importing the arbiter build, so this package typechecks standalone. Tests use a mock arbiter and never resolve the real client.
